title: My account
error: Something went wrong, please try again

password.title: Password
password.hint: At least 10 characters. Changing it signs you out on other devices.
password.failed: Couldn’t change the password; check your current password
password.tooShort: The new password must be at least 10 characters
password.googleOnly: You sign in with Google; your password is managed by your Google account.

data.title: My data
data.description: Download everything stored in your account (profile, resumes and their versions, consents, reviews) as one JSON file. Your password and session keys are never included.

close.title: Close account
close.description: Your resumes and their versions are deleted for good, your personal details are anonymised and you are signed out. This can’t be undone; download your data first.
close.admin: Admin or editor accounts can’t be closed here; the role must be removed first.
close.confirm: Type your e-mail address to confirm ({email})

username.label: Username
username.hint: Shown as the owner of templates you make public, and used for your profile address. 3–30 characters; lowercase letters, digits, - and _.
username.format: Use only lowercase English letters, digits, - and _; start with a letter and don't end with - or _.
username.reserved: This username is reserved; choose another.
username.taken: This username is taken; choose another.
